verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a secrets-scanning CLI and platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the CLI, pre-commit hooks, custom-detector verification webhooks and alert routing. Nothing shows an official MCP server or endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
